description: Controlled vocabulary defining superplasticizer types used in the material_batches tab of the Concrete Grand Challenge Experimental Database.

entries.definition: Superplasticizer reported without a specific chemical classification or product type.
Superplasticizer based on sulfonated melamine formaldehyde or related melamine-sulfonate chemistry.
Superplasticizer based on sulfonated naphthalene formaldehyde or related naphthalene-sulfonate chemistry.
Superplasticizer based on polycarboxylate ether chemistry.
Modified polycarboxylate-based superplasticizer or related polycarboxylate derivative.
Superplasticizer type that does not fall within the predefined categories.
Superplasticizer type not reported or not identifiable from the available documentation.
